agent_home.description: The agent's own configuration directory; empty is the agent's default.

additionalProperties.description: The agent's model name for the tier.

agent_models.description: Per agent, a model name for each model tier.

brief.description: The brief: one headless call that previews each unit.

max_input_bytes.description: The most bytes of input a brief reads, between 1000 and 200000.

cleanup.description: The thresholds of the session and workspace cleanup workflows.

asked_idle.description: How long a session that asked you stays idle before it closes.

disposable.description: Ignored files and directories a tool recreates, so removing a workspace that holds them loses nothing.

idle.description: How long a finished session stays idle before it closes.

manual_idle.description: How long a session you started stays idle before it closes.

stale_workspace.description: How long an untouched workspace stays.

workspace_grace.description: How long, in working time, a workspace stays after its unit finished.

dossiers.description: The dossiers' lifecycle and quotas; a value of zero or less keeps its default.

archive_after.description: How long after its unit or project resolved a dossier is archived.

compact_at_kb.description: The log size that triggers compaction.

max_file_mb.description: The largest file a dossier keeps; a larger one is linked.

purge_after.description: How long after the archive it is purged.

soft_cap_mb.description: The size per dossier doctor reports.

total_cap_mb.description: The size of dossiers and archives doctor reports.

drafts.description: The settings every proposer's drafts share.

repeat_after.description: The default repeat_after a config.drafts.repeat_after reference reads, and the plugin rules' delay before they propose a settled draft's key again.

address_checks.description: Failing checks on the head of a pull request you develop start an address round.

address_conflicts.description: A pull request you develop that conflicts with its base past the conflict window starts an address round.

address_reviews.description: Someone's review of a pull request you develop starts an address round.

address_skip_reviewers.description: Logins whose reviews never start an address round.

address_without_workspace.description: An address round creates its author workspace when it has none; off, the sweep only records it.

automated_reviewers.description: Logins of review bots whose reviews count as automated.

drafts.description: The drafts the plugin's own rules propose.

approval.description: Their approval; left out, each waits for you.

window.description: How long a delay waits before the draft goes; only with mode delay.

enabled.description: Switches the GitHub plugin; left out, it is on.

followups_without_workspace.description: A follow-up review recreates the review workspace the user deleted; off, the sweep only logs it.

ignore_checks.description: Checks whose failure never starts an address round.

silent_days.description: Calendar days of silence on a pull request before a nudge is due; workflows read it as config.github.nudge.silent_days.

owners.description: The GitHub owners automated follow-ups run on; empty is every owner the workspace manager knows.

rate_limit_fraction.description: The share of the GitHub rate limit the sweeps may spend, a number between 0 and 1.

review_prefix.description: The prefix of a review workspace's name.

scope.description: Whose pull requests the GitHub plugin follows.

people.description: Logins whose pull requests it follows.

repos.description: Repositories whose pull requests it follows.

teams.description: Teams whose pull requests it follows.

stalled.description: When a pull request counts as stalled.

merge.description: Approved and unmerged for this long.

reply.description: Waiting on a reply for this long.

review.description: Waiting on a review for this long.

trusted_authors.description: Logins whose pull requests pass the author association check of automated rounds.

areas.description: The areas an entry is offered.

contexts.description: The contexts an entry is offered.

stale_waiting_days.description: Working days after which a waiting entry goes stale.

headless.description: The headless turns' caps; a cost of zero leaves it uncapped.

per_call_usd.description: What one call may cost, in USD.

per_day_usd.description: What they may cost in a day, in USD.

tier.description: The model tier of their calls.

project_settings.description: Where the intent's sessions load the checkout's own agent settings.

when.description: Where the intent's sessions load the checkout's settings; elsewhere they start without them.

intents.description: Each intent's settings, by intent name.

heat.description: How long a unit stays warm.

warm_for.description: How long a unit stays warm after its last item resolved; left out, the heat reader's default.

mcp.description: The daemon's MCP endpoint, which agent homes register.

digest_at.description: The local HH:MM of the daily digest; empty for none.

placement.description: The rules that place units; the first match wins.

checkout.description: The branch their work checks out.

repo.description: The repository their work checks out.

profile.description: The user profile layered over the bundled one: a name under the profiles directory, or a path; an intent's profile names an intent.

projects.description: Settings for the pull requests of matching repositories; the first match wins.

agent.description: The agent the project's sessions run.

github.description: The GitHub settings the project overrides.

match.description: An owner/repo pattern, such as acme/* or acme/api.

workspace_managers.description: The managers a new worktree of the project picks from, in order.

projects_dir.description: Where review clones a repository the workspace manager does not know yet.

slack.description: The Slack plugin's settings; no secret lives here.

client_id.description: The Slack app's client id; empty leaves Slack unconfigured.

drafts.description: The drafts the plugin's own rules propose.

approval.description: Their approval; left out, each waits for you.

window.description: How long a delay waits before the draft goes; only with mode delay.

enabled.description: Switches the Slack plugin; left out, it is on.

extraction.description: The extraction job; a zero value keeps its default.

context_chars.description: The characters of those messages; 0 is 4000, -1 turns them off.

context_messages.description: The read-only messages shown before a DM's window; 0 is 10, -1 turns them off.

enabled.description: Switches the extraction job; left out, it is on.

escalate_over_chars.description: A unit whose rendered conversation is longer goes to the frontier tier; 0 or -1 is off.

language.description: The language the extraction writes in; empty is English.

max_failures.description: Failed calls in a row after which the job gives up on a unit until its next change; 0 is 3.

max_wait.description: The longest delay of a unit's oldest change; empty is 10m.

per_call_usd.description: What one extraction call may cost, in USD; 0 is 0.10.

per_day_usd.description: What extraction may cost in a day, in USD; 0 is 3.

quiet.description: How long a unit stays unchanged before it runs; empty is 90s.

tier.description: Its model tier; left out, fast.

window_chars.description: The characters of conversation one call reads; 0 is 40000.

ingest.description: What the Slack plugin admits and how it listens.

allow_apps.description: Bot ids (B...) or app ids (A...) whose messages are admitted.

deny_apps.description: Bot ids (B...) or app ids (A...) whose messages are not.

since.description: The first start's backfill date, YYYY-MM-DD; empty is 7 days back.

socket.description: Listens on a socket; left out, it does.

terms.description: A message that holds one of them as a word, in any case, is admitted.

keychain_service.description: The name of the Keychain items; empty is the brand's.

post_allowlist.description: When not empty, the only channel ids, or user ids naming the DM with that user, a post may go to.

redirect_port.description: The login callback port registered in the Slack app; 0 is 53682.

request_log.description: Logs one line per Slack call: method and HTTP status.

turns.description: What a turn on a Slack unit reads.

max_chars.description: The characters of the unit's messages rendered into the instructions; 0 is 30000.

per_day.description: Automated turns per day, all workflows together, on units whose plugin keeps no per-unit count (every provider but GitHub today).

per_unit_per_day.description: Automated turns on one unit per local day, on units whose plugin keeps a per-unit count (GitHub today); every automated turn spends one, whatever its intent declares, and a turn by hand none.

columns.description: The sink's column for each status: working, working-fallback, needs-me, reviewed, ready, in-progress, in-review, completed.

views.description: Each view sink's own settings, by sink.

approval.description: The approval of the workflow's runs, over the manifest's field by field.

mode.description: The mode when no rule matches; left out, the manifest's.

rule.description: Rules tried in order before the mode, the first match wins; set, they replace the manifest's, and [] clears them.

window.description: The rule's delay; only with mode delay.
How long a delay waits before it goes; only with mode delay.

approval.description: The approval of the workflow's drafts, over the manifest's field by field.

mode.description: The mode when no rule matches; left out, the manifest's.

rule.description: Rules tried in order before the mode, the first match wins; set, they replace the manifest's, and [] clears them.

window.description: The rule's delay; only with mode delay.
How long a delay waits before it goes; only with mode delay.

enabled.description: Switches the workflow; left out, it is on.

observe.description: Plans the workflow's items pending, for you to run; left out, the manifest's.

only_when.description: A condition ANDed with the workflow's when.

workflows.description: Overrides of each workflow's manifest, by workflow name.

workspace_managers.description: The enabled workspace managers, in the order a new worktree picks them.
